reproducer_source:
import hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
work=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=work.parents[2]
roots={'baseline':root/'.build/source-performance-plan','candidate':root/'.build/source-reuse-e9ecd6d'}
goose=root/'.toolchain/goose/build/goose'
hashfile=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report={'started_utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'compiler_sha256':hashfile(goose),'flags':'goose --standalone -O2; gcc -O2 -DGS_STACK_STATS=1 -lm -ldl -lpthread','samples':[],'builds':{},'script_sha256':hashfile(Path(__file__)),'scope':'Separate instrumented whole-process storage observations, including fixture/expected buffers and runtime startup; no per-call heap/RSS or timing claim.'}
binaries={}
for name,path in roots.items():
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(path),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip();assert not before
 c=work/f'{name}-storage.c';binary=work/f'{name}-storage'
 subprocess.run([str(goose),'source/tests/profile_costs.goose','--standalone','-O2','-o',str(c)],cwd=path,check=True)
 subprocess.run(['gcc','-O2','-DGS_STACK_STATS=1',str(c),'-lm','-ldl','-lpthread','-o',str(binary)],check=True)
 binaries[name]=binary
 report['builds'][name]={'commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'engine_sha256':hashfile(path/'source/editor.goose'),'fixture_sha256':hashfile(path/'source/tests/profile_costs.goose'),'c_sha256':hashfile(c),'binary_sha256':hashfile(binary)}
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{6})
cases=[['source','remove','0','10000','0'],['legacy','remove','0','10000','0'],['source','set','1000000','1','0'],['legacy','set','1000000','1','0']]
for i in range(9):
 for case in cases:
  for name in (list(roots) if i%2==0 else list(reversed(roots))):
   run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-f','RESOURCE\t%M\t%R\t%F',str(binaries[name]),*case,'1','8'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30)
   lines=run.stderr.strip().splitlines();assert len(lines)==2 and lines[0].startswith('goose stack stats:')
   fields=lines[1].split('\t');assert fields[0]=='RESOURCE' and len(fields)==4
   stacks=re.search(r': (\d+) data stacks, (\d+) regions',lines[0]);assert stacks
   result=run.stdout.strip().split('\t');assert len(result)==11 and result[:5]==case and result[5:7]==['1','8']
   report['samples'].append({'round':i,'runner':name,'case':case,'runtime_stats':lines[0],'stacks':int(stacks[1]),'regions':int(stacks[2]),'max_rss_kib':int(fields[1]),'minor_faults':int(fields[2]),'major_faults':int(fields[3]),'checksum':int(result[-1])})
for name,path in roots.items():
 assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(path),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
 assert hashfile(binaries[name])==report['builds'][name]['binary_sha256']
 assert hashfile(path/'source/editor.goose')==report['builds'][name]['engine_sha256']
 assert hashfile(path/'source/tests/profile_costs.goose')==report['builds'][name]['fixture_sha256']
assert hashfile(goose)==report['compiler_sha256']
report['completed_utc']=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())
report['reproducer_source']=Path(__file__).read_text()
(work/'reuse-storage.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print({name:sorted({s['stacks'] for s in report['samples'] if s['runner']==name}) for name in roots})
